summary: Builds a key by including pixels whose red, green, and blue values fall inside configured channel ranges, with soft falloff controls.

key_params.name: redmin
key_params.note: Minimum red value included in the key.

key_params.name: redmax
key_params.note: Maximum red value included in the key.

key_params.name: greenmin
key_params.note: Minimum green value included in the key.

key_params.name: greenmax
key_params.note: Maximum green value included in the key.

key_params.name: bluemin
key_params.note: Minimum blue value included in the key.

key_params.name: bluemax
key_params.note: Maximum blue value included in the key.

common_gotchas: A pixel must satisfy all RGB ranges to be included in the key.
Soft-low and soft-high values control edge falloff; hard ranges can create noisy mattes.
Invert New Alpha flips the generated matte but does not solve poor threshold choices.
RGB output and alpha output settings decide whether this TOP creates a matte, cutout, or diagnostic view.
key_concepts: Builds a matte by testing whether red, green, and blue values fall inside configured ranges.
A pixel must pass all enabled RGB min/max tests to be included in the key.
Per-channel soft-low and soft-high controls shape matte falloff around thresholds.
RGB Output and Alpha Output controls decide whether the node returns a cutout, matte view, or alpha-only change.
